list_note: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, via the Exophase and PSNProfiles lists (which agree on every name, description and grade). 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 27 visible, 28 hidden until earned. Guides are this entry's own words, written November 2026 from the official descriptions and the launch-week guides cited beside each trophy; where a step is not yet confirmed by any source, the guide says so instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. Nothing about it needs multiplayer or DLC — every trophy is offline single-player, and one playthrough is enough. PowerPyx puts the whole run at roughly 200 hours at difficulty 4 out of 10, with the 100% checklist as the long tail. Work the roadmap in order and this one pops last.
steps: Finish the story (Stage 1)
Clear activities and side strands (Stage 2)
Finish collectibles and money goals (Stage 3)
Complete the 100% checklist for A Long Road — the platinum follows

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: it unlocks when you finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. There is nothing to hunt for and nothing to miss — just play the opening mission through. PowerPyx lists it as the first story beat of the game.
steps: Play Chapter 1's opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story trophies unlock on their own as the plot advances, so this one is a matter of playing through the opening chapter's missions. The story runs five chapters and about 60–80 hours in total, per PowerPyx.
steps: Complete every main mission in Chapter 1

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it is automatic and cannot be missed — keep following the main missions after Chapter 1 ends.
steps: Complete every main mission in Chapter 2

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Automatic story trophy; it pops when the chapter's final mission ends.
steps: Complete every main mission in Chapter 3

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy, and a useful checkpoint: the optional Chapter 4 mission “That's Where The Money Is…” unlocks bank-vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal, so take it before the story moves on.
steps: Complete every main mission in Chapter 4
Take the optional mission “That's Where The Money Is…” while you are here — it opens bank vaults

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the gold story trophy: five chapters in, the last mission ends the story and this pops. There is free-roam after the credits but no mission replay, so anything tied to a mission has to be done on the way through.
steps: Play the story to its final mission and finish it
After the credits, free-roam stays open for cleanup — but missions cannot be replayed

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission trophy: play the mission when it appears in the story and finish it. Nothing about it is missable as long as you play the mission itself.
steps: Play the Breakfast Run mission to completion

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission trophy — it pops when the heist ends. Heist missions are the big set-pieces, so expect a longer mission with a planned escape.
steps: Play The Cartel Heist to completion

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story mission trophy: it unlocks when the mission ends, with nothing extra to do.
steps: Play Child's Play to completion

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story mission trophy — finish the mission and it pops.
steps: Play Headliners to completion

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story mission trophy; the airport setting is also where Catch Me If You Can lives, so note the layout for later.
steps: Play VCIA Takedown to completion

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story mission trophy — finish the operation and it pops.
steps: Play Operation Savage Glory to completion

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players earn: reach 100% on the completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which opens after the story. PowerPyx stresses the thresholds are lenient — roughly 60% of true completion — and most of the checklist fills itself while you chase the other trophies. You need any 70 of the 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 30 different race wins, 15 card sets, 8 bank vaults, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied.
steps: Finish the story first — the checklist opens after it
Work the trophy goals first: their targets sit below the checklist targets
Mop up the remaining checklist lines (challenges, stunts, scans) in free-roam

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the game's 397 stunts. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses and airtime moments the game tracks as you drive and fly; flying under bridges is reported as the quickest way to rack them up. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going after this pops.
steps: Fly under bridges — the fastest stunt source reported
Any 250 of 397 count; the checklist later wants 300

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The game tracks activities under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and scrolling over each one shows how many you have done. One try each is enough — no wins or medals needed here.
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see the 9 types
Try each type once

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 in total, and the 100% checklist counts the same 42, so golding them all serves both goals at once. Work through them range by range rather than grinding one weapon.
steps: Visit the Shooting Range and work through all 42 challenges
Gold each one — the checklist needs the same 42

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. PowerPyx counts 14 drone race locations and 42 races in total, so the trophy is one win per location, not every race. Learn one course per location and move on.
steps: Race at all 14 Top Fun locations
One win per location is enough

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — road, off-road, drone or otherwise — so pick the formats you are best at. The 100% checklist raises the bar to 30, so keep racing after this pops.
steps: Win 20 different races
The checklist later wants 30

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head contests against Cal, so the trophy is about out-fishing one rival rather than catching a particular fish. Exophase shows this as one of the earliest-earned trophies, at about 1.9% of players when the list went live.
steps: Take on a fishing challenge against Cal
Out-fish him to win the challenge

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida, play a full game through to its end, and the trophy pops — no high score needed. Any arcade game counts.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet
Play one arcade game to completion

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the strangers whose mission strand runs across the story; finish his chain and this pops. TechWiser warns — from a single source — that stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so start Andy's strand as soon as it unlocks rather than leaving it for the end.
steps: Start Andy's stranger strand when it unlocks
Play it through to its final mission

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same shape as the other stranger finales: start Kenton's strand when it appears and play it through to the end.
steps: Start Kenton's stranger strand when it unlocks
Play it through to its final mission

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's stranger strand from its first mission to its last.
steps: Start Billy's stranger strand when it unlocks
Play it through to its final mission

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than 8 strands in the state, so pick the ones you enjoy — the five named finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus Bret's hunt and others all count toward the 8. Start strands when they unlock; a single-source warning says some have windows tied to story progress.
steps: Start stranger strands as they unlock
Complete any 8 strands

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's stranger strand end to end.
steps: Start Randy's stranger strand when it unlocks
Play it through to its final mission

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's stranger strand end to end.
steps: Start Tyrone's stranger strand when it unlocks
Play it through to its final mission

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. GTABase counts 18 meditation spots; the 100% checklist counts 15, and the two sources may be counting different things, so visit every spot you find. This is the one trophy both PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, reported gone after that chapter. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe — PowerPyx's author earned the trophy after doing it.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house — do not leave this for later
Visit every other meditation spot across Leonida as you find them

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand asks for one specific animal, and which animal it is has not been pinned down by the guides yet — the launch-week roundups list it as unconfirmed. Start Bret's strand when it unlocks and watch for the hunt mission; the target should be named in the mission itself.
steps: Start Bret's stranger strand when it unlocks
Take the hunt mission — the target animal is named there

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida in sets; any 3 finished sets earn the trophy, while the 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so keep collecting after this pops. Track sets in the collectibles menu as you go.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida
Complete any 3 sets (the checklist later wants 15)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game scanning app: point it at landmarks and points of interest until 100 locations are logged. The 100% checklist wants the same 100, so this trophy and the checklist line finish together.
steps: Use WAiNK on landmarks and points of interest
Log 100 locations

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in total and any 50 count, so skip the hardest ones. The 100% checklist needs any 70 of the 80, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.
steps: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges
Skip the hardest — the checklist later needs 70

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and get out of the red heat zone on the map. The guides suggest a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a hiding spot, and bank vault robberies often trigger the wanted level you need.
steps: Reach 4 stars with your partner alongside
Escape the red heat zone until the wanted level clears

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The trick is staying wanted the whole time: hit three shops in a row with your partner, moving fast between them. The jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together, which helps; if it does not pop after the third, rob a fourth.
steps: With your partner, rob a shop while wanted
Hit two more shops in a row without losing the wanted level

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. GTABase says to scan vehicles with WAiNK without driving them — scanning traffic near busy roads is efficient. Any 100 different vehicles count, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so keep scanning as you travel.
steps: Scan vehicles with WAiNK — no need to drive them
Scan traffic near busy roads; 100 different vehicles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus meter first, trigger Combat Focus, and drop 5 enemies before it runs out — an assault rifle is the suggested tool. The guides report that gang members count, while cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to, so pick a gang fight for the attempt.
steps: Fill the Focus meter, then trigger Combat Focus
Drop 5 gang members in the one use

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. GTABase's read: steal a docked passenger jet at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away from the airport. Expect a wanted level on the way in — go in fast and get airborne.
steps: Get to a docked passenger jet at VCIA
Steal it and fly about 1 km clear of the airport

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. GTABase's read: steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. The Rhino is the tank — get in, and use its cannon on enemies until the trophy pops.
steps: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station
Take out enemies from inside the tank

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The reported approach: use the Snap Gun on the store's back door, find the safe code, and empty the safe without ever being spotted. Go at a quiet hour, stay out of sight lines, and leave before the alarm state changes.
steps: Use the Snap Gun on the jewelry store's back door
Find the safe code, empty the safe, and leave unseen

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults open up after the optional Chapter 4 mission “That's Where The Money Is…”: follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open, then get out. Expect 4 stars and plan a fast bike for the escape. The 100% checklist wants 8 vaults, so keep robbing after this pops.
steps: Do the optional Chapter 4 mission “That's Where The Money Is…”
Follow a security van into a bank while the vault is open, rob it, and escape — 5 vaults total

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, take its cash, and lose the wanted level that follows. Trucks run set routes, so pick a quiet stretch of road for the hit.
steps: Ambush an armored truck and take its cash
Escape and lose the wanted level

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The map's fog lifts as you visit each region — clear the fog everywhere and the trophy pops. Flying over the dark patches is reported as the quickest way to cover ground.
steps: Visit every region until the map fog is gone
Fly over dark patches to clear them fast

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. GTABase counts 9 gangs, so this is 9 robberies — one operation per gang. Hit the operations as you find them across the state and keep a note of which gangs you have done.
steps: Find illegal operations across Leonida
Rob one belonging to each of the 9 gangs

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description points at a specific bar spot on Ocean Beach, but the exact steps are not yet known — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet pinned down. The honest read: head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view, and order a cocktail; if it does not pop, the trigger is still unconfirmed and this guide will be updated when a source pins it down.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find a bar with a view
Order a cocktail there

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. PowerPyx lists this one as not yet known. GTABase suggests it means crashing a car out through a showroom window — unconfirmed, but the natural reading of the description — so try driving a car through the showroom's glass.
steps: Get a car inside a vehicle showroom
Drive it out through the showroom window

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The wording is unclear and the exact trigger is not pinned down by the guides yet, but the setting is plain: go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. A full game — follow-through suggests finishing your turn properly — is the sensible first try.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Play a game of bowling through

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. GTABase's read: max out Strength for both characters. Train Strength with each of Jason and Lucia until both are maxed — gym work and physical activity build it over time.
steps: Build Strength for Jason to the max
Build Strength for Lucia to the max

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). GTABase ties this to the Criminal Profile: 500 actions that change your profile. That is a single-source figure, so treat it as a guide, not gospel. One caution from the roundups: the Irredeemable profile state is permanent, so read a Criminal Profile guide before going on a rampage for this one.
steps: Do actions that change your Criminal Profile — 500 is the reported figure
Check a Criminal Profile guide first: Irredeemable is permanent

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description is a riddle and the trigger is unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, and no guide has pinned it down. The name hints at failing once and succeeding on the second try; until a source confirms it, this entry records it as unknown rather than guessing.
steps: No confirmed steps yet — listed as not yet known by PowerPyx

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Another riddle trophy with no confirmed trigger yet. GTABase points at a strange event somewhere in Leonida, but neither it nor PowerPyx has confirmed the steps. The honest entry: watch for an unusual encounter in free-roam and check back — this guide will be updated when a source pins it down.
steps: No confirmed steps yet — a strange event somewhere in Leonida is the reported lead

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The name and description point at bowling-pin chaos from a moving vehicle — a melee weapon swung from a vehicle at pins or pin-like targets. The exact steps are not yet known per PowerPyx, so this is the best reading of the description until a guide confirms it.
steps: No confirmed steps yet — a melee drive-by at bowling pins is the reading of the description

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; fences (contacts) wash them into clean cash, and one fence is reported to pay the most. The total builds up across the robberies you do for the 100% checklist anyway, so keep laundering as you go.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is washed

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any spending counts — weapons, clothes, food, vehicles — so this fills itself as you gear up, and it can be finished quickly by buying big-ticket items. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough.
steps: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops
Big purchases finish it fastest

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, about $160,000 in all, and the 4 story garages do not count toward them. Buy all 8 and the trophy pops.
steps: Open the Vice City Real Estate app
Buy all 8 garages (about $160,000 in total)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app lets you register vehicles you find, so register 10 different vehicles through it. Any 10 count.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app
Register 10 vehicles through it
